values.name: User-Centered
values.description: User experience is at the core of everything I build. I iterate continuously based on user feedback and data.

values.name: Efficiency
values.description: I believe in the 80/20 rule: deliver most of the value early to gather feedback faster, fail earlier, and create more time for polishing.

values.name: Teamwork
values.description: I do not need to be the best at everything. I rely on my team when needed and support others the same way. Teaching each other is one of the best ways to grow.
